description.value:
Frequency once per hour

Trigger You successfully use Stealth to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Hide] and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Hidden] from all of your current foes, or use Stealth to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Sneak] and become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Undetected] to all your current foes.

When you slip out of sight, you disappear. You become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Invisible] for 1 minute, even if you use a hostile action. Not even @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Revealing Light], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.See the Unseen], or similar effects can reveal you, though creatures can still use the @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Seek] action to locate you as normal.

Nothing can prevent you from making a sneak attack, even if your opponent can see every blow coming. Instead of dealing the damage from @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Sly Striker], you can deal your full sneak attack damage to a target even if the target isn't @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Off-Guard].

Trigger You would be hit by an attack or targeted by an effect, or you are within an effect's area.

Requirements You have @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.feats-srd.Item.Perfect Distraction] ready to use.

You reactively switch with your decoy to foil your foe. You use Perfect Distraction, even if you were observed, as long as you end the movement of your @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Sneak] while @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Concealed] or in a location with cover or greater cover. Your decoy is targeted by the attack or effect instead of you. In the case of an area effect, if your Sneak doesn't move you out of the area, both you and the decoy are targeted by the effect.
